description: Integrate the memory service into the existing validation pipeline and chat endpoint. Auto-capture validation results as memories, inject relevant context into new validations, and enhance the chat endpoint to reference past validations. Add new API endpoints for memory operations (list, search, delete).
steps: Step 1: Create backend/app/api/memory.py with a new Flask blueprint 'memory_bp'. Endpoints: GET /api/memory/sessions (list past sessions with pagination), GET /api/memory/sessions/<session_id> (get session detail with associated memories), POST /api/memory/search (body: {query, limit?, type?} - search memories), DELETE /api/memory/<memory_id> (delete a memory), GET /api/memory/stats (return counts: total memories, total sessions, memories by type).
Step 2: Register the memory blueprint in backend/app/api/__init__.py following the existing pattern (import memory_bp, will be registered in app factory).
Step 3: Register the memory blueprint in backend/app/__init__.py create_app() with url_prefix='/api/memory', following the same pattern as validation_bp registration.

Step 4: Modify backend/app/api/validation.py _run_validation() to auto-capture completed validations as memories. After task_manager.complete_task(), call MemoryService to: (a) end the current session with a summary extracted from the report, (b) store the validation result as a 'semantic' memory with tags from keywords/categories, (c) store patterns/observations as 'episodic' memories.

Step 5: Modify backend/app/api/validation.py _run_validation() near the beginning: before running analysis, call memory_service.inject_context(idea_text) to get relevant past context. Pass this context to the ReportGenerator and IdeaAnalyzer so they can reference past validations.

Step 6: Modify backend/app/api/validation.py chat() endpoint: before building the LLM context, search memories for relevant context using the user's message. Append relevant memories to the system prompt so the AI can reference past validations in conversation.

Step 7: Modify backend/app/services/report_generator.py generate_report() to accept an optional memory_context parameter. If provided, include it in the prompt as a '## Relevant Past Insights' section so the LLM can reference historical validation data.

Step 8: Create backend/tests/test_memory_api.py with tests for: GET /api/memory/sessions returns list, POST /api/memory/search returns results, GET /api/memory/stats returns counts, DELETE removes memory. Mock the MemoryService.
Step 9: Update backend/tests/test_api.py to ensure existing validation endpoints still pass with the memory integration (the memory service should be initialized but not block if DB is empty).
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/memory/sessions returns a JSON list of past validation sessions
POST /api/memory/search with a query returns relevant memories
Completing a validation automatically stores the result as a memory
The chat endpoint includes relevant past memories in its context
New validations get context from past related validations injected
All existing tests continue to pass
